note: The directed graph is data, not code. Validation rules are NOT written as if/else chains; they are read from these adjacency lists at startup.

standard.name: Standard process graph
standard.description: Linear journey plus one legal shortcut LOADING -> ARRIVAL (short-haul bags that are not transferred).

deadend.name: Quarantine (dead-end) process graph
deadend.description: Alternate DEMO configuration. ARRIVAL is still reachable from CHECK_IN and SECURITY (via the direct re-route SECURITY -> ARRIVAL), but LOADING now routes bags to QUARANTINE, which has no outgoing transition. After LOADING, ARRIVAL is unreachable, and only the BFS reachability check can detect that.
